Every prediction with its resolution criteria and my notes. See the [predictions page](index.qmd) for how this works. Click a column header to sort.

*Effort* is how much work went into a probability, so you can weigh each call accordingly: a **quick take** is a gut call from public information, **considered** means I worked through polls or crosstabs, and a **deep dive** rests on my own analysis or model.
